preconditions.expression: all(c in '.X' for line in stdin.splitlines() for c in line)
preconditions.description: Every character in the grid is either '.' (unmarked) or 'X' (marked).

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == n and all(len(line) == m for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: The grid has exactly n rows and m columns, where n and m are the first two integers in stdin.
Grid dimensions n and m are integers between 1 and 500 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i < n-1 and 1 <= j < m-1 for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if stdin.splitlines()[i][j] == 'X')
preconditions.description: No marked cell ('X') is adjacent to the grid's edge (i.e., all marked cells are at least one cell away from the border).

postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output is exactly 'NO'. Otherwise, output starts with 'YES' followed by n lines of m space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or all(all(c in '1 4' for c in line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Every unmarked cell ('.') in the output grid contains either 1 or 4.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or all(all(int(c) % 5 == 0 for c in line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] for c in line.split() if grid[i][j] == 'X')
postconditions.description: Every marked cell ('X') in the output grid contains a multiple of 5, where grid is the input grid and i, j are the cell coordinates.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or all(int(grid[i][j]) == sum(int(output_grid[i+di][j+dj]) for di, dj in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)] if 0 <= i+di < n and 0 <= j+dj < m and grid[i+di][j+dj] == '.') for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if grid[i][j] == 'X')
postconditions.description: Every marked cell ('X') in the output grid contains the sum of the numbers in all adjacent unmarked cells ('.'), where grid is the input grid and output_grid is the output grid.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.strip().startswith('YES') and all(all(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: All output grid cells are valid integers (no non-digit characters except spaces).
